name: std::ranges::iterator_t, std::ranges::const_iterator_t, std::ranges::sentinel_t, std::ranges::const_sentinel_t
intro:
1) Used to obtain the iterator type of the type T.

2) Used to obtain the constant iterator type of the range type R.

3) Used to obtain the sentinel type of the range type R.

4) Used to obtain the constant sentinel type of the range type R.

sections.title: Template parameters
sections.text:
T

 -

 a type that can be used in std::ranges::begin


 R

 -

 a range type or a sized_range type

sections.title: Notes
sections.text: iterator_t can be applied to non-range types, e.g. arrays with unknown bound.

summary: 1) Used to obtain the iterator type of the type T.
